notes.title: Bug Fixes, Controller Support and 2017 Steam key revokes
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30355231/7622ad13f60d3d74e3cf8082179f90c488a87b44.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30355231/178caa9e45a7ab5606e9179cdd8c6b174fcbfd26.png[/img][/url]
Hello, we are terribly sorry for the lack of communication. This is primarily due to us being a very small team which makes working on the game and communicating with the community sometimes challenging. 

-we are currently working on adding controller support.

-we have fixed the email icon on our website.

-Issues with level 2 music are being addressed as the music was supposed to activate when player reaches a certain location. (We have begun testing on this issue and it will be resolved)

- Story Notes: A check point was added in the tutorial section so players wouldn’t have to read the story notes again and again. We are looking into the possibility of restructuring the tutorial level to allow for more check points.

[b]
-Revoking Keys 2017: [/b]
In keeping with steam key policy some but not all keys in 2017 where revoked, this is due to:

-The Keys where issued for the alpha version of the game and advertisement.
-The keys where found being sold on other sites not affiliated with five12 games, this action was the main cause of keys issued in 2017 being revoked. The keys where intended as a giveaway not to be resold for profit, this action went against Steam key policy and insult the customers who payed full price for the game. No further keys received in giveaways/ for review purposes will ever be revoked.

notes.title: It's finally here
notes.content:
It's been a long wait but we are proud to announce that Orn the tiny forest sprite is finally out. We hope you guys enjoy the game as much as we did making it.

We are hard at work fixing any bugs or issues that come up so please feel free to let us know of any bugs you stumble across.

The best issue discovered wins a FREE Orn shirt of your preferred size.

Bugs or issues fixed:
- Check point in tutorial section added before the first jump.
- Level two title screen not working (issue has been resolved)
